messages:
sofia (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Leadership promised more color on hiring priorities and the new team mapping. I'll start a thread for Q&A. Please drop short questions and we'll answer live.
kevin (CEO): short answer first: prioritize product-critical roles and platform reliability. longer answer below.
mitesh (VP Product): can we clarify time horizons? are we talking hires for next 90 days vs FY?
kevin (CEO): @mitesh good q — 90 days = tactical (backfills + high-impact ICs for core infra). FY = strategic (managers, platform scale, private deployments).
tara (Head of Eng): to add — engineering will consolidate from 14 teams to 11 squads over next two quarters. that means some lead roles shifting. not layoffs, mostly rerolls and backfills.
emma (Eng Manager): can you confirm if manager headcount is frozen? we've had folks ask about people manager growth.
kevin (CEO): manager headcount is limited in Q1 — hire only where it unlocks >2x throughput or critical compliance work. otherwise we prefer senior ICs.
dave (Engineer): curious about contractors — are we encouraged to use contractors to bridge gaps while we reorganize?
tara (Head of Eng): yes, limited contractor usage allowed for short-term bursts (<=6 months). long-term ownership roles should be full-time.
alex (Recruiter): practical note: if a hiring owner wants a req, please file on the new template. link: https://redwood/internal/hiring-req (see section "priority buckets").
sofia (People Ops): we'll publish the headcount sheet tomorrow. preview snippet:
```
Q1 tactical: 12 net-new (infra 6, infra-sre 2, product 4)
Q2 strategic: 18 net-new (platform 8, enterprise 6, research 4)
Backfills: 9
```
mitesh (VP Product): how are we measuring "impact" for priority? is there a rubric?
kevin (CEO): yes — impact rubric includes: user-visible latency/cost improvements, revenue enablement, legal/compliance risk reduction. People Ops will share the rubric doc.
emma (Eng Manager): re: team mapping, will there be an official mapping for shadowing/mobility?
sofia (People Ops): yes — we'll run a 2-week internal mobility window after the mapping is published. leaders need to post stretch opportunities in #internal-moves.
dave (Engineer): heads-up — some of my teammates are worried about role clarity after squad consolidation. can leadership share signals that a role is stable vs being evaluated?
tara (Head of Eng): stable roles get an explicit "owner retained" flag in the mapping doc. evaluated roles will have a 30-day transition note.
alex (Recruiter): timeline for new reqs: once approved, ETA to post is ~7 business days (shorter for priority buckets).
kevin (CEO): also want to emphasize: we expect a bump in hiring approvals for infra and reliability work — that's non-negotiable to keep SLAs.
sofia (People Ops): great qna — we'll compile these into a short FAQ and link in the all-hands notes. if you want to follow up privately, DM me or @alex. :thumbsup:
